t: A Raspberry Pi RP2040 board in a micro:bit style shape with an LED dot matrix.
steps: Find the Pico:ed V2 page on the ELECFREAKS maker site.
Check that the board is in stock.
Connect the board to a computer by USB.
Choose a supported editor for MicroPython or C++. The materials do not name one.
Confirm that the editor works on your computer type. Chromebook support is not confirmed.
Run a first program that lights the dot matrix.
Test any micro:bit accessories before you plan a lesson around them.
